proposed_clause_text./fence_contract/rule: The external controller serializes original-attempt admission at each enumerated operation cut. Revocation denies every subsequent admission. An operation already admitted may finish only its declared finite effects and descendants before its declared safe cut, inside the original scope, fixed deadline and pre-spent budget. This permits effects after a forward-revocation request but never new operation admission, a renewed deadline or unbounded completion.
proposed_clause_text./forward_contract/in_flight: Each admitted operation requires independently reviewed exact graph/effects/identities/descendants, finite limits, valid original rights and known safe cut. Missing or unknown cut prevents admission; a cut label, backend return or stop request is not known drain. Scoped recovery/evidence/publication keeps its own original rights and is not blanket exempt.
proposed_clause_text./forward_contract/termination: Forward revocation closes new admission irreversibly and requires original admitted operations to reach a declared safe cut. Expiry, original deadline or any failure retains absorbing stop; no effect beyond the original permitted finite scope/deadline is authorized. Unknown stopping or completion remains pending. No new operation, launch, grant, retry, refund or reacquisition follows.

adversarial_schedules.conditional_reason: The candidate has no intervening live effect gate. A later expiry or poll cannot authorize the intervening effect.
Macro admission is not continuous admission for subsequent real nested effects.
The static rule contains no original live-authority serialization; hypothetical additional enforcement is outside this candidate.
Request acknowledgement is not completion. Even completion alone is not independently proven full effect/storage drain.
Assumes a mutable shared pointer buffer and no independent argument protection; rejects only this unprotected composition.
A notification response is not a proven gate spanning the later actual effect boundary.
Earlier admission is not erased. Identify actual safe stopping boundaries and independently retain/drain obligations; do not assert all previously admitted effects are atomically undone.
Unknown stays pending with rights consumed; no retry, refund, renewed deadline, rebind or second launch.
Forward-only revocation is not proof of retained recovery validity; recovery needs original explicit finite live scope and known prerequisites.
Collector/injector/evidence/publication own writes require their own original scoped gates; observation roles confer no exemption.

candidates.alternative_review_without_relaxation: Review an external original-attempt gate spanning every actual effect; do not lengthen, renew or create per-action grants.
candidates.candidate_specific_unsatisfied_obligatio: Revocation can occur after the last accepted observation and before the next actual effect. Signature authenticity and expiry limits do not serialize that interval.
candidates.composition_as_stated: Worker uses a signed launch receipt or periodically checks validity, then mutates without another actual-effect gate.

candidates.alternative_review_without_relaxation: Refine the complete actual backend/helper/selector/hook graph and identify every effect admission and safe in-flight boundary.
candidates.candidate_specific_unsatisfied_obligatio: Revocation between two internal backend effects remains unmediated even when the backend macro admission was valid.
candidates.composition_as_stated: Controller checks before a backend invocation; nested commands and internal effects execute without continuous gating.

candidates.alternative_review_without_relaxation: Evaluate a complete independently enforced policy composition; static filtering can be a limited constituent, never the live fence itself.
candidates.candidate_specific_unsatisfied_obligatio: Allowed syscall metadata alone does not observe a later change in external original authority, nor cover all target objects, asynchronous work and writers.
candidates.composition_as_stated: A fixed allowlist permits backend mutation syscalls; no reviewed mechanism connects fresh external revocation to their actual effect lifetimes.

candidates.alternative_review_without_relaxation: Treat process controls as possible containment constituents with known membership, protected lifetimes and independently observed drain; no claim of instantaneous cancellation.
candidates.candidate_specific_unsatisfied_obligatio: A task may act before freeze completion; already admitted effects and external writers remain obligations. Process-status evidence cannot by itself settle storage and effect uncertainty.
candidates.composition_as_stated: Controller reacts to revocation by requesting freeze or kill and treats the request or task status as whole-effect closure.

candidates.alternative_review_without_relaxation: Review protected consumption and actual effect-level authority serialization under a separate policy; no assumption that listener placement satisfies original no-worker-broker compatibility.
candidates.candidate_specific_unsatisfied_obligatio: A peer may change pointer bytes before kernel consumption; authority may change after response and before a later actual effect. A valid notification ID does not authenticate original rights or freeze arguments.
candidates.composition_as_stated: An external notifier inspects target pointer data and current authority, then sends CONTINUE; no independent argument protection or complete effect gate is included.

candidates.alternative_review_without_relaxation: Identify an actual composition and independently review its whole enforcement/trust/source/lifetime graph before any separately scoped selection or native test grant.
candidates.candidate_specific_unsatisfied_obligatio: No exact native enforcer, source graph, primitive, protocol, platform support, failure behavior or independent conformance is selected. Naming a gate is not its implementation.
candidates.composition_as_stated: Hypothetical protected external enforcer serializes fresh original authority with every real effect admission and safe in-flight boundary, independent of worker-held service capability.
